description: Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max have been launched in China. The new Vivo X500 is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600M chipset, while the Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max are powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC. The new Vivo X500 Pro Max and Vivo X500 will go on sale in China on September 24, while the Vivo X500 Pro will be available for purchase starting September 29. All three phones will be available via the Vivo Xhina online store. The Vivo X500 is offered in Dawn, Echoes of the Earth, Night Photography, and Sunny (translated from Chinese) colour options. Meanwhile, the Vivo X500 Pro series is offered in the Viewing the Sunset colourway, instead of the Dawn shade, apart from the three finishes mentioned above.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max, X500 Pro Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Chipset, Vivo X500 Tags Along: Price, Features

description: Boat has launched the Airdopes Prime 800D in India at Rs. 1,999, with a separate non-AI variant priced at Rs. 1,599. The TWS earbuds feature 11mm dynamic drivers, Dolby Audio, 24-bit Spatial Audio and four AI-ENx microphones. They support Bluetooth 6.1, Multipoint Connectivity and a 45ms low-latency mode. The earbuds are claimed to deliver up to 45 hours of playback and carry an IPX5 rating. Crest AI is also available on the Airdopes Prime 701 ANC and Nirvana Ion ANC.
title: Boat Airdopes Prime 800D With Google Gemini-Based Crest AI, Up to 45 Hours of Battery Life Launched in India

description: Googlebook design leaked online ahead of the formal launch. It appears to have a metallic aluminium chassis with slim bezels around a bright display. The laptop seems to have a desktop-oriented user interface with home screen widgets, including weather, calendar, and stock tickers, placed on the left. A taskbar is seen at the bottom.
title: Googlebook Render Leaked Again Ahead of Launch; Reveals Slim Profile

description: Vivo's new open-ear TWS earbuds use a flexible titanium alloy bridge and weigh 5.2g per earbud. The Buds Clip support Hi-Res Audio Wireless, LDAC and three-device connectivity over Bluetooth 5.4. They also offer spatial audio, custom EQ settings, AI-based call noise reduction and real-time translation when paired with compatible Vivo and iQOO devices. The earbuds are claimed to provide up to 10 hours of playback, extending to 42 hours with the charging case, which supports USB Type-C charging.
title: Vivo Buds Clip With Open-Ear Design, Up to 42 Hours of Battery Launched: Price, Features

description: Special-edition smartphones can be a bit of a mixed bag. We’ve seen several instances in the past where the manufacturer has simply changed the colour, added a logo or two, thrown in a themed wallpaper, and called it a day. But when done right, special edition models offer a unique experience. This approach is exactly what Realme has taken with its latest Warner Brothers’ collaboration, the product of which is the new Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition.
title: Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition First Impressions

description: WhatsApp is reportedly testing a chat customisation feature that could let participants use the same theme across a conversation. The proposed option may synchronise wallpapers and chat bubble colours, including custom backgrounds selected from a user's photo library. Users could retain control over their own appearance or choose to share the selected customisation with others. The feature may also support group conversations, where participants could see a shared theme. It was spotted on an iOS beta build and remains under development.
title: WhatsApp May Let You Share Custom Wallpapers and Chat Themes With Others

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is now available for purchase in India, following its launch earlier this month. The latest Fan Edition smartphone sits below the flagship Galaxy S26 series. It brings several features from Samsung’s premium lineup, including a 120Hz Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, the Exynos 2500 chipset, and a triple rear camera setup. It runs on One UI 9 and packs a 4,900mAh battery with 45W wired charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE With Exynos 2500 Chip Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Nothing will soon spin off CMF as a standalone Indian firm, Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Founder Carl Pei announced on Monday. However, after the restructuring, Nothing, the current parent company, will remain a stakeholder. CMF is already headquartered in India. It became an independent entity, registered and headquartered in the country earlier this year, in January.
title: CMF to Become Indian, Nothing’s Carl Pei Announces While Highlighting India’s ‘Inevitable’ Growth Potential

description: Gmail is rolling out a Copy code button for two-factor authentication emails. The new feature is available on both Android and iOS. The update is said to be appearing in Gmail for Android version 2026.09.07.x and Gmail for iOS version 6.0.260907. It is currently not available in Gmail on the web. The pill-shaped Copy code button is shown under the subject line alongside the email preview.
title: Gmail Adds ‘Copy Code’ Shortcut for Copying Verification Codes on Android and iOS

description: Google’s Gemini model reportedly accessed the internet and hacked other companies during a test of its cybersecurity capabilities. The incidents happened during cybersecurity testing by Irregular. In one case, Gemini guessed passwords until it gained access; in the other two, it found credentials in a public repository. Google chose not to publicly disclose the hacks, claiming that no harm was caused to the target companies.
title: Google Gemini Reportedly Hacked Three Companies During Cybersecurity Test

description: Ai+ Nova Tab will be launched in India soon, the company has confirmed. The upcoming device is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Flipkart and will be offered in at least an orange colour option. The Ai+ Nova Tab is shown to feature a flat rear panel, with a square-shaped camera module placed in the top-right corner. The company branding is placed in the middle panel, finished in a white shade. In terms of the specifications, the Ai+ Nova Tab is confirmed to be powered by an octa-core Unisoc T760 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.2GHz. The tablet will also feature 8GB of RAM and 128GB of onboard storage. Moreover, it will sport an 11.97-inch touchscreen.
title: Ai+ Nova Tab India Launch Teased; Key Specifications, Design Revealed

description: The iPhone 20 Pro series could feature a new display design with curved edges and a punch-hole cutout. The iPhone 20 Pro is reportedly being tested with a 6.41-inch panel, while the Pro Max could use a 6.96-inch screen. Both displays are expected to maintain a pixel density close to 460ppi. Earlier reports have pointed to Apple's work with Samsung and LG on curved display technology, while other leaks have suggested an under-display camera design for the anniversary iPhone.
title: iPhone 20 Pro Could Get a Major Display Redesign With Quad-Curved Panel

description: Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) continues to add new rewards for players through its regular redeem code drops. The latest codes offer the Secret Legacy Backpack as the highlight reward. Similar to previous drops, Krafton India, the developer behind the popular online multiplayer battle royale game, has released 50 redeem codes, with each code unlocking exclusive in-game rewards. The codes are available for a limited period, and players will need to redeem them through BGMI's official Redeem Centre.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for September 21: How to Get Secret Legacy Backpack and Other Free Rewards

description: Vivo Y600K Turbo has appeared on the Google Play Console. The listing reveals several key details about the upcoming Vivo Y-series smartphone. It is likely to come with a Snapdragon chipset. The Vivo Y600K Turbo will reportedly arrive as a rebranded version of the Vivo Y600 Turbo. It was spotted with model number V2553A and device code PD2553.
title: Vivo Y600K Turbo Surfaces on Google Play Console; Launch Seems Imminent

description: Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition was launched in India and global markets on Monday. The handset arrives as a limited edition variant of the Realme 16 Pro 5G, which was introduced in January. The new Realme handset carries an identical set of features and specifications to the standard model, but has cosmetic changes inspired by Warner Brothers’ fantasy films, including stylised nano-engraved motifs and custom user interface (UI) themes.
title: Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: The Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition brings the company's existing TWS earbuds a themed makeover inspired by the Wizarding World. The earbuds feature 12.4mm drivers, Hi-Res Audio Wireless support and LHDC 5.0, along with up to 50dB active noise cancellation. They also offer Bluetooth 6.1 connectivity, 45ms low latency and support for connecting three devices simultaneously. Battery life is rated at up to 56 hours with the charging case, while the earbuds carry 62mAh batteries each.
title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition Launched in India: Price, Features

description: OnePlus Ace 7 series will be launched with a new "sophisticated" technology, a tipster claims. The new technology will reportedly help elevate the performance of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset to “a whole new level”. While the leaker did not specify which technology the OnePlus Ace 7 series will be launched with, the report claims, citing other posts, that it could be a new thermal management system. The OnePlus Ace 7 is said to feature a large active cooling fan, which will allow the handset to dissipate heat away from the chipset and other core components faster. If this is true, it might reduce the chances of throttling due to overheating.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Series to Launch With a New ‘Sophisticated’ Technology for Notable Performance Upgrade, Tipster Claims

description: Lava Virat Curve 5G has been launched in India with a 6,000mAh battery. It has a 6.67-inch full-HD+ (1,080x2,400 pixels) 3D curved AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC. The handset is IP64-rated for dust and splash resistance. Lava Virat Curve 5G has a 50-megapixel Sony IMX752 primary camera.
title: Lava Virat Curve 5G Launched in India With MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Ai+ Nova 2 Power 5G was launched in India as the latest smartphone in the company's Nova 2 series. The new handset packs a 7,000mAh battery paired with 33W fast charging. It sports a 6.78-inch 120Hz display and is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset. It also comes with up to 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. The Ai+ Nova 2 Power 5G runs Android 16 with the company's nxtQ OS and includes a dual-camera setup at the back.
title: Ai+ Nova 2 Power 5G Launched in India With Dimensity 7100 SoC, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: After its first teaser, Motorola has released another, revealing more details about its upcoming flagship. The Motorola Signature 27 is teased to come in two colourways and will have a 200-megapixel primary rear camera. The Signature 27 is expected to be the successor the Motorola Signature launched in January this year.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Announcement Date Revealed, 200-Megapixel Camera and Two Colours Teased

description: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy has said that Grand Theft Auto 6's multiplayer mode will launch in 2027. GTA 6 is releasing on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 19, 2026, but Rockstar Games has not yet shared its plans for the game's multiplayer mode.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6's Multiplayer Mode Will Launch Next Year, Says Twitch CEO

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be launched in China on September 23 at 7:00 pm local time (4:30 pm IST), the smartphone maker announced on Sunday. The lineup is expected to include two models, namely the Xiaomi 18 Pro and the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max. Both smartphones are teased to launch in at least three colour options, dubbed Black, Starry River Blue, and White. Apart from this, the tech giant has also revealed the display features of the Xiaomi 18 Pro series. Additionally, the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be launched this week with the new hardware-level privacy display functionality, which will work similarly to Samsung’s Privacy Display technology.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Launch Date Announced as Firm Teases New Privacy Display Feature, Colour Options

description: Apple's first dedicated smart home display could launch in October, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The home hub will offer controls for connected devices, video calls, intercom capabilities, and media. It will offer Apple services and apps. It will also feature a new operating system built around Siri AI. It could feature a camera, microphones, and a roughly square display.
title: Apple’s First Smart Home Display Could Launch Next Month: Here's What You Need to Know

description: Flipkart's Big Billion Days Early Bird Deals will bring discounts on a range of smartphones and electronics from September 24. The preview includes the iPhone 17, Samsung Galaxy S25, Vivo T5x 5G, Realme P4 series, Motorola Signature and Lava Virat V1 5G. The sale will also feature Samsung laptops, 65-inch 4K TVs and Goboult watches. Buyers can get 10 percent savings with select bank cards, while Super.money, Super Pay in 3 and Flipkart Pay Later will offer additional payment benefits.
title: Flipkart The Big Billion Days Early Bird Deals Announced: Date, Deals, and Bank Offers Revealed

description: After all the leaks and rumours, OnePlus has officially revealed the design of its upcoming number series smartphone. Officially called the OnePlus 16, the phone is listed for preorder on Oppo’s China website and will be available in three colourways and four RAM and storage variants.
title: OnePlus 16 Design, Colours and Storage Variants Revealed as Phone Goes Up for Pre-Order in China

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 is all set to begin in India soon. The annual festive sale is expected to bring deals across smartphones, electronics, fashion, beauty, home essentials, and groceries. Ahead of the commencement of the sale, the e-commerce giant has also announced new product launches and discounts across premium and value segments during the shopping event. Customers will get an instant discount on card transactions, while Prime members can unlock additional savings.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 Sale Date Announced: SBI Discount, Prime Offers Teased

description: Apple Pay could finally make its India debut next month. First introduced in the US in 2014, the payment service has been absent from one of the world's largest digital payments markets despite Apple's growing presence in the country. According to a seasoned journalist, Apple Pay is expected to support card-based payments, while its potential integration with India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) could make the service more relevant to local users. The development comes after months of discussions between Apple and Indian banks and payment networks.
title: Apple Pay India Launch ‘Finally’ Set for October, Says Mark Gurman
